authorization: 사용자가 전체 개선 실험의 병렬 재실행을 요청했다.
probability_calibration: Each ensemble member has its own training-only preprocessing/risk model; fit SVC on 2 folds, sigmoid-calibrate FrozenEstimator on the other fold, then never refit that SVC or its calibrator. Average 3 calibrated probabilities.
full_data_definition: All source rows partitioned 80/20 per seed. Every outer-training row is used for fitting in two members and calibration in one. Each member fits 2/3 of the outer training rows; this is a calibrated ensemble, not one SVC on all outer training rows. No source-row cap, subset selection or kernel approximation.
threshold: Primary probability threshold fixed at 1/6 for cost 5FN+FP. Hyperparameters selected on inner validation cost at this threshold. Secondary tuned_probability uses validation-selected calibrated-probability threshold, not an uncalibrated margin.
matched_backbone: Fix C, gamma_factor, alpha and entanglement at the baseline-selected primary setting; select only lambda by validation cost for each risk transformation. All zero-lambda checkpoints share baseline probabilities exactly.
search_budget: Common exhaustive C and geometry grids, not equal candidate counts: risk variants have the additional lambda factor. Zero-lambda evaluations cached/reused. Disclose counts/time; separate fully tuned performance from matched-backbone mechanism comparisons.
risk: Original calibrated LR and 5-fold out-of-fold training risks, fitted strictly inside each ensemble member's fit rows. No calibration/validation/test labels enter preprocessing, LR risk fitting or SVC fitting for that member.

transforms.weights: normalized absolute LR coefficients in the common 7-dimensional training PCA basis
transforms.scaling: common untransformed member-training PCA min/range, clipped to [0,pi]

PQK: Supplementary projected kernel: 21 one-qubit Pauli X/Y/Z expectations after the same ZZ circuit, Gaussian kernel with gamma=gamma_factor/21. This is not an independent new quantum-advantage claim.
main_multiplicity_family: 72: 4 datasets x 3 policies x (4 within-kernel RBF/QSVC + 2 quantum-minus-classical interactions). Preserve this family; individual corrected-resampled 95% CIs, two-sided paired tests and Holm p.
supplementary_families: PQK within-kernel tests separately across all policies; shuffled/constant controls separate; no test-result-driven family change.
timing: Record member fit/calibration preprocessing, quantum state/projection, train/calibration/test kernel, SVC fitting, sigmoid calibration and probability prediction separately. Sum member stages per standalone ensemble; do not treat duplicated/shared candidate timings as actual experiment wall time. Parallel-load timings not isolated benchmarks.
interpretation: Exploratory revised study after viewing earlier test results and selected-seed diagnostics. Same outer data/splits reused, not an untouched independent confirmatory evaluation. Preserve old results and disclose this adaptive study history. No promised improvement or hardware speed advantage.
excluded_method_change: Do not replace the original risk formulas with a new risk-channel circuit without separate methodological approval. Projected kernel is supplementary, not a replacement for the six requested main models.
